title: Components of the second derivative of a smooth integrand are smooth
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) (= Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) and Psi : L -> R of class C^infinity (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)). Then for all P, Q ∈ L the scalar function R ↦ D^2Psi(R)[P][Q] = fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) R P Q is of class C^infinity on L.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ → ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun R : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) R P Q)
